# AgentMeasure

> Free local checks for Codex / Claude Code logs and reproducible agent metering verification. Human-delivered diagnostics: $10 Healthcheck and $20 Metering QA. Last reviewed: 2026-10-14.

## Start here

- [Website](https://roy-tong.github.io/AgentMeasure/): overview and local quickstart
- [Services](https://roy-tong.github.io/AgentMeasure/services.html): input requirements, prices, turnaround and refunds
- [Healthcheck](https://github.com/roy-tong/AgentMeasure/blob/main/healthcheck/README.md): CLI 0.7.0, local session checks, sharing and supported commands
- [SDK](https://github.com/roy-tong/AgentMeasure/blob/main/sdk/README.md): Provider SDK 0.2.0 on npm
- [Release notes](https://roy-tong.github.io/AgentMeasure/releases.html): independent package versions and dated releases

## Service and evidence limits

Analysis runs locally; a user may explicitly send a summary or redacted sample. `share --out` writes immediately to a local file; inspect before sending. Confirmation is not payment. Work starts only after payment, fit approval and complete input. First response within 24 hours; delivery within 24 hours after those conditions, unless a different slot is agreed before payment.

Summary counts support interpretation, not guaranteed root-cause diagnosis. Core FMT-002 does not verify token/cache semantics, invoice amounts or pricing accuracy. Missing evidence remains UNPROVABLE. Technical findings and synthetic fixtures are not customer value or paid-demand proof.
